body:
There is not a ton of information out there about this compound so I thought I would write a few things about it.
This substance has recently surfaced as an analogue of MXE, so it is
similar to Ketamine. I never officially took real Ketamine but I did use MXE a few times about 6 - 7 years ago. What I will say about this substance is use caution and start with small amounts.
The first few days I experimented with it, even at super small amounts I was having a pretty strong experience. It starts with a heaviness behind the eyes which leads to a strong "disso" feeling after about 5 - 10 minutes. Since this drug is pretty similar to MXE which is pretty similar to Ketamine, it will raise
blood pressure slightly initially
. I take medication for  high blood pressure and I read online Ketamine is safe for people with high BP as long as they are taking medication for it.
The effects of this substance I find are great for self exploration, ego loss and sex. When I take a small amount before sex, I find I am a much more caring lover and I feel like I connect with my partner. I can feel their pain and pleasure and I was able to take my partner to great heights of climax through my empathy and better understanding of their body and mind.
I also have had better insight about myself with this compound. DMXE is great for ego loss, and I also like to take a little before bed and explore the closed eye visuals etc. I have always considered dissos to be a "night time" drug because they enhance the darkness and usually visual are more clear with
my eyes closed or in the dark as the mind fills in the blanks.
At larger doses,
I will know immediately when
I am getting close to the hole. My ears started ringing slightly and then time distorts, in my case I could feel every second and how my experiences were changing in real time
.
I find this substance very useful for spiritual exploration, empathy, helping with depression and sex. I think it could be used as a "club drug" of course, but for me personally, that would be a little too intense. I prefer this substance in the comfort of my bed, in the dark.
I sometimes get mild headaches after I come down or the next morning.
